title: SEC6: STARTTLS resets auth state, no re-greeting
description: run_session_post_starttls (lifecycle.rs) creates a fresh SessionContext (clearing authenticated_user, pending_auth_user, auth_failure_count) after a successful STARTTLS upgrade, but does not send a new server greeting. Both constraints are required by RFC 4642 §2.2 and have distinct security motivations: clearing auth state prevents an eavesdropper who saw a pre-TLS credential exchange from carrying those credentials into the now-encrypted channel; suppressing the greeting is required by the RFC and avoids a second greeting that some newsreaders would misinterpret as a server reset. The two constraints work in opposite directions (reset vs. continue), making it non-obvious that both must hold simultaneously. Decision: new SessionContext + no greeting.
